facts.fact: The Government of South Sudan eServices portal lists a Ministry of Justice New E-Business Portal to register and manage a business, partnership or company online.
facts.system: Ministry of Justice - New E-Business Portal

systems.system: Ministry of Justice - New E-Business Portal

SSD.note: Portal catalogue states no core finance, revenue or payroll system in use.
Nothing on civil register and ID links.
The civil registry directorate appears only with passport and eVisa services; no digital birth or death registration stated.

facts.fact: The Government of South Sudan's eServices portal lists 14 ministries and agencies with 47 named online services, such as passport, eVisa, licence and permit applications and eTax, as retrieved on 11 November 2026.
The eServices portal, an account page, describes itself as secure single-window access to public and private services and carries the services of 14 ministries and agencies.

SSD.note: No sign-in by national ID is stated, and no user or transaction counts.
Nothing on a number at birth.

facts.fact: The eServices portal describes the South Sudan National Bureau of Standards as the national regulatory body mandated for the quality, safety and standardization of goods and services, established under the SSNBS Act, 2012.
facts.system: South Sudan National Bureau of Standards

systems.system: South Sudan National Bureau of Standards (SSNBS)

SSD.note: No national standard on information technology or data and no certification stated.
Passport and eVisa services only; no local civil registration office entering births or deaths digitally.

facts.fact: The eServices portal says all taxpayers, citizens, foreigners, businesses and NGOs can now apply for a Taxpayer Identification Number on eTax online through the South Sudan Revenue Authority Domestic Division.

SSD.note: No sharing of the number with business registration or customs, and no tie to a national ID, stated.
